interruption--noun.def: Something that stops an activity for a while.

sob--verb.def: To cry loudly while taking short breaths.
sob--verb.ex: The child sobbed for an hour.
sob--verb.exTr: Çocuk bir saat hıçkıra hıçkıra ağladı.

ballot--noun.def: A secret vote, or the paper used for it.
ballot--noun.ex: Put the ballot in the box.

complexion--noun.def: The natural colour and condition of the face.

holocaust--noun.def: The destruction of a very large number of people.

exhaustion--noun.def: The state of being extremely tired.

legislation--noun.def: Laws considered together, or the making of them.

entrepreneur--noun.def: A person who starts a business and takes the risk.
entrepreneur--noun.ex: A young entrepreneur opened the café.

long-distance--adj.def: Travelling or reaching over a long way.
long-distance--adj.ex: He is a long distance runner.

genre--noun.def: A style or type of art, music or writing.

prefect--noun.def: A senior pupil with duties, or a local official.

publication--noun.def: A book or magazine, or the act of publishing.

luxurious--adj.ex: They stayed in a luxurious suite.

showcase--noun.def: An event or a place that displays something well.
showcase--noun.ex: The fair is a showcase for local food.
showcase--noun.exTr: Fuar yerel yemekler için bir vitrin.

replica--noun.def: An exact copy of an object.

wondrous--adj.def: Strange and beautiful, in poetic English.

instruct--verb.def: To tell someone officially what to do, or to teach them.
instruct--verb.ex: The doctor instructed her to rest.

optimism--noun.def: The belief that good things will happen.

humane--adj.def: Showing kindness and avoiding causing pain.

trolley--noun.def: A small cart for carrying goods or shopping.
trolley--noun.ex: Take a trolley at the entrance.

earnings--noun.def: The money a person or a company earns.

righteousness--noun.def: The quality of being morally right.
righteousness--noun.ex: He spoke of duty and righteousness.

eruption--noun.def: The sudden throwing out of lava by a volcano.
eruption--noun.ex: The eruption covered the town in ash.

setback--noun.ex: The fire was a serious setback.

novelty--noun.def: The quality of being new and unusual.

doubtful--adj.ex: It is doubtful that he will come.

indebted--adj.def: Owing money, or grateful for help.
indebted--adj.ex: We are indebted to our neighbours.

implement--noun.def: A tool used for a particular job.
implement--noun.ex: A spade is a simple implement.

implement--verb.def: To start using a plan or a decision.

supervise--verb.def: To watch over work or people to check it is done well.

outline--noun.def: A short description of the main points, or a shape's edge.

brochure--noun.def: A thin book with information about a product or a place.
brochure--noun.ex: Take a brochure from the desk.

utility--noun.def: A service such as water or electricity, or usefulness.

snore--noun.def: The rough sound some people make when asleep.
snore--noun.ex: His snore woke the whole tent.

prescribe--verb.def: To say officially what medicine a patient should take.

blindness--noun.def: The state of being unable to see.

tack--verb.def: To fasten something with a small nail or a pin.
tack--verb.ex: She tacked the map to the wall.

incentive--noun.def: Something that encourages you to do something.

outing--noun.def: A short trip made for pleasure.
outing--noun.ex: The class went on an outing.

audit--noun.def: An official check of financial records.

literal--adj.def: Following the exact words, not a figure of speech.

trainee--noun.def: A person who is learning to do a job.

accommodation--noun.def: A place to stay or to live.

mutton--noun.def: The meat of an adult sheep.
mutton--noun.ex: The stew is made with mutton.

orchestral--adj.def: Written for or played by an orchestra.
orchestral--adj.ex: The film has an orchestral score.

endlessly--adv.def: Continuing for a very long time.

redo--verb.def: To do something again, usually better.
redo--verb.ex: She had to redo the exercise.

predicament--noun.def: A difficult situation with no easy answer.
predicament--noun.ex: We were in a real predicament.

ideology--noun.def: A set of political or social beliefs.

stride--verb.def: To walk with long confident steps.

downfall--noun.def: The loss of power or success, or its cause.

beneficial--adj.ex: Walking is beneficial for the heart.

philosophical--adj.def: Relating to philosophy, or calm about difficulty.

astronomy--noun.def: The study of stars and planets.

fascination--noun.def: A very strong interest in something.
fascination--noun.ex: His fascination with maps began early.

evaluate--verb.def: To judge carefully how good or useful something is.

microscopic--adj.def: Too small to see without a microscope.

ointment--noun.def: A thick cream rubbed on the skin as medicine.
ointment--noun.ex: Put the ointment on twice daily.

electrician--noun.def: A worker who installs and repairs electrical systems.

actively--adv.def: In a way that involves real effort.

assurance--noun.def: A promise that something is true or will happen.

bossy--adj.def: Always telling other people what to do.

bio--noun.def: A short account of a person's life.
bio--noun.ex: Read her bio on the website.

wasp--noun.def: A flying insect with black and yellow stripes that stings.
wasp--noun.ex: A wasp flew into the kitchen.

delicacy--noun.def: A special rare food, or great care and sensitivity.
delicacy--noun.ex: Sea urchin is a local delicacy.
